name: Prometheus metrics
author: NetMaster
description: Lets monitoring systems read NetMaster's measurements in the standard Prometheus format: response times, packet loss, services, uptime checks, speed tests and which devices are online. Works with Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog, Elastic, Checkmk and others.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: The measurements are at http://<this computer>:<port>/metrics.

settings.label: Token (recommended)
settings.help: If set, the reader must send "Authorization: Bearer <token>". In Prometheus: authorization: {credentials: <token>}.

settings.label: Include every device
settings.help: Online state, name, IP and live traffic per device. Turn off for fewer measurements.
